berlin.name: Berlin

list.name: Berlin glutenfrei
list.by: the Berlin contacts of the German Coeliac Society (DZG)

tips: Oats and wheat starch: in Germany, food labelled glutenfrei can contain gluten free oats (Hafer) or gluten free wheat starch (Weizenstärke). This app counts oats as gluten, so ask: Ist da Hafer oder Weizenstärke drin?

Packaged food: look for glutenfrei or the crossed grain symbol. In Germany the DZG licenses the symbol for products tested at under 20 mg of gluten per kg. Supermarkets, drugstores and organic shops sell food labelled glutenfrei.
Before you go: opening times change, and many of these places close one or two days a week or only open in the evening. Check the website first. Some take card only.

places.name: Oshione

locations.note: Oshione Atelier, baked at the main bakery

says.text: 100% gluten free and natural.

places.listed: Bakes only gluten free: bread, rolls and sweet pastries. The owner has coeliac disease.
notes: Its website says a fourth branch, at Oranienburger Straße 54 in Mitte, opens in autumn or winter 2026.

places.name: AERA

says.text: Glutenfreie Bäckerei Berlin

places.listed: Bakes only gluten free: sourdough bread, sandwiches and sweet pastries. Card payment only.
places.caution: Its shop sells an oat biscuit (Haferkeks). Ask which items contain oats.
notes: Its website lists both shops but not their opening hours.

places.name: PURE NOGLUTEN

says.text: Unsere Küche ist vollständig glutenfrei, sodass Menschen mit Zöliakie oder Glutenunverträglichkeit bei uns sicher genießen können.
says.en: Our kitchen is completely gluten free, so people with coeliac disease or gluten intolerance can eat here safely.

places.listed: Coffee, cakes and pastries baked daily, and savoury snacks. Everything gluten free.
notes: Its notice on gluten says it relies on suppliers' labelling for bought-in products, and takes no responsibility for suppliers' mistakes.

places.name: Jute Bäckerei

locations.hoursNote: Open on public holidays unless it says otherwise

places.listed: Bakes only gluten free: bread, rolls, baguettes and sweet baked goods. Also sold at some Bio Company organic shops.

says.text: Mit unserem Geschäft eröffnete 2014 eine rein glutenfreie Bäckerei, in der wir alles frisch herstellen.
says.en: Our shop opened in 2014 as an entirely gluten free bakery, where we make everything fresh.

places.caution: Its breakfast menu offers oat milk ("Hafer (glutenfrei)"), porridge and muesli. Ask which items contain oats.

places.name: Café Prana

says.text: Everything on my menu is gluten-free, safe for coeliacs and those with sensitivities.

places.listed: Everything on the menu is gluten free, plant based and sugar free.
notes: A small café.

places.name: EasyPeasy
places.type: Café: breakfast, waffles, pancakes and bowls
places.listed: Everything is gluten free and baked in its own kitchen, except the oat milk, which is kept and prepared completely separately. It doesn't use gluten free wheat starch. Gluten free oats are used now and then, and labelled. The owner has coeliac disease.
places.caution: It serves oat milk, and some items have gluten free oats. Ask for them to be left out.
places.statusNote: Its website blocked the app's check again, so its opening times weren't confirmed.

places.name: Café Velicious

says.text: Alle unsere Speisen sind für Personen mit Zöliakie geeignet, da wir komplett auf glutenfreie Weizenstärke verzichten.
says.en: All our food is suitable for people with coeliac disease, because we don't use gluten free wheat starch at all.

places.listed: Everything is gluten free and vegan, made by a trained pastry chef.
places.caution: Some items contain oats (its menu marks them "Ha"), and it serves oat drinks. Ask for them to be left out.

places.name: Pretty Hill
places.listed: Bakes only gluten free: cakes, tarts, ice cream, sandwiches and some soups. The owner has coeliac disease.
places.statusNote: It has no website, only Instagram, so its opening times weren't confirmed.

places.name: Sinless Cakes
places.claimLabel: Says its cakes are gluten free

says.text: Wir können mit Stolz sagen, dass alle unsere Kuchen glutenfrei - hauptsächlich mit Mandelmehl gebacken - und ohne zugesetzten Zucker sind.
says.en: We can proudly say that all our cakes are gluten free (baked mainly with almond flour) and have no added sugar.

notes: Its words cover the cakes. Ask about anything else it serves.

places.name: Berliner Cantuccini

says.text: bio-zertifiziert, glutenfrei und vegan
says.en: certified organic, gluten free and vegan

places.listed: The whole range is gluten free. No ingredient containing gluten is used anywhere in the business, and its flours are certified gluten free.
notes: A small shop. It also sells online.

places.name: Soul Kitchen House

says.text: Dedicated Gluten-Free Kitchen · Celiac-Safe · Allergy-Friendly

places.listed: All dishes are vegan and gluten free. Asked by the support groups, it said the whole kitchen uses only gluten free products.

places.name: Trattoria Senza

locations.hoursNote: Its website gives slightly different times in one place.

says.text: Unsere Gerichte sind für alle geeignet: für Menschen mit Zöliakie oder Laktoseintoleranz ebenso wie für gesundheitsbewusste Genießer
says.en: Our dishes suit everyone: people with coeliac disease or lactose intolerance as well as health-conscious food lovers

places.listed: An Italian restaurant that's entirely gluten free and lactose free: pasta, lasagne, tiramisu.
notes: Card payment only.

places.name: Tapiocaria

locations.hoursNote: Its website lists opening times for Wednesday to Sunday only, so Monday and Tuesday show as closed

places.listed: All dishes are gluten free, staff know about it, and the owner is happy to advise. Almond milk for coffee.
places.caution: Only the support groups' list says it's all gluten free. Its own website doesn't mention gluten, so confirm when you order.
notes: Book through its website.

places.name: Zeus Pizzeria

says.text: Wir sind durch die Deutsche Zöliakie-Gesellschaft e.V. geschult und Geprüft.
says.en: We have been trained and inspected by the German Coeliac Society.

places.listed: Gluten free pizzas have their own menu. They're topped in a completely separate kitchen, from separately stored ingredients, and baked in a separate oven.
places.caution: Its regular pizzas are made with wheat flour in the same restaurant. Order from the gluten free menu and say you have coeliac disease.

footNotes: That list also has places it says have some gluten free dishes. They're left out here because their kitchens also use gluten, unless they say they make gluten free food separately.
Unofficial guide. Not affiliated with any of these places or the DZG.

amsterdam.name: Amsterdam

also.name: Gluten-free food in Amsterdam
also.by: I amsterdam, the city's official guide

footNotes: The Dutch Coeliac Society's list also has places with its mark that serve some gluten free dishes, such as Hans im Glück on Rembrandtplein and some McDonald's branches. They're left out here because their kitchens also use gluten.
Other guides call Rose & Vanilla, Croque Madame and Wild & The Moon all gluten free, but their websites couldn't be checked, so they're left out until they can be.
Unofficial guide. Not affiliated with any of these places or the NCV.
tips: Oats and wheat starch: Dutch food labelled glutenvrij can contain gluten free oats (haver) or gluten free wheat starch (tarwezetmeel). This app counts oats as gluten, so ask: Zit hier haver of tarwezetmeel in?
Chips: the Dutch Coeliac Society says chips are often fried in the same fryer as food with gluten, so ask whether there's a separate gluten free fryer.
McDonald's: the Dutch Coeliac Society says more than 200 McDonald's restaurants in the Netherlands sell its gluten free burgers, but not every branch does.
Before you go: these places close on some days and keep short hours. Check the website first.

places.name: Craft Coffee & Pastry

says.text: Je vindt onze 100% glutenvrije bakkerijen midden in de gezellige Pijp in Amsterdam
says.en: You'll find our 100% gluten free bakeries in the middle of lively De Pijp in Amsterdam

notes: It's on the Dutch Coeliac Society's list of places with its Zorgeloos Glutenvrij mark. The society says it checks them before they get the mark and then again, unannounced.
Its website says orders to collect are taken only through its webshop. Croissants, bread, cakes and coffee.

places.name: De Glutenvrije Winkel

says.text: Ontdek onze collectie van heerlijke glutenvrije producten. Van vers gebakken brood tot zoete lekkernijen.
says.en: Discover our collection of delicious gluten free products, from freshly baked bread to sweet treats.

notes: Its name means The Gluten Free Shop; its website also calls it flour·ish. It isn't on the Dutch Coeliac Society's list.

places.name: Bloem Eten & Drinken

says.text: Onze keuken is volledig plantaardig en glutenvrij.
says.en: Our kitchen is entirely plant based and gluten free.

notes: It's on the Dutch Coeliac Society's list of places with its Zorgeloos Glutenvrij mark. The society says it checks them before they get the mark and then again, unannounced.
Book by phone (020 3300929) or by email (bloem36@gmail.com).
places.caution: Its menu says it uses certified gluten free oats (haver). Ask which dishes have oats and leave them out.

london.name: London

list.name: 100% Gluten Free London Restaurants, Cafes and Bakeries

also.name: Gluten Free London: A Complete Guide
Gluten free places to eat in London

tips: Oats: food labelled gluten free in the UK can contain oats, and many cafés offer oat milk. This app counts oats as gluten, so ask whether anything has oats in it.
Beer: ordinary beer and lager contain gluten. Some of these places also sell a beer labelled gluten free, so ask which one it is.
Before you go: small places change their hours, and some open only a few days a week. Check the website or social media first.
footNotes: Guides also name Holy Carrot, Station 26, Apres Food Co, Romeo's, Lu-Ma, Cookies & Scream and Pearl & Groove, but their websites no longer say everything is gluten free, or they appear to have closed, so they're left out.
Market stalls such as Khanom Krok, Arepazo Bros and Floris' Bakery are left out because only guides say everything is gluten free, or the guides disagree.
Unofficial guide. Not affiliated with any of these places or the guides named here.

locations.hoursNote: Its website gives later closing times: 01:00 Monday to Wednesday, 03:00 Thursday to Saturday. The app shows midnight

says.text: The menu is entirely gluten, nut, and celery-free
